+from ansible.plugins.filter.core import to_uuid, to_yaml, to_nice_yaml
+from ansible.errors import AnsibleFilterError, AnsibleUndefinedVariable

 UUID_DEFAULT_NAMESPACE_TEST_CASES = (
@@ -39,3 +43,32 @@ def test_to_uuid_invalid_namespace():
     with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as e:
         to_uuid('example.com', namespace='11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555')
     assert 'Invalid value' in to_native(e.value)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_func', (to_yaml, to_nice_yaml))
+def test_yaml_filter_undefined(filter_func):
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_func', (to_yaml, to_nice_yaml))

+        filter_func(object())
+    assert filter_func.__name__ in str(error.value)
+    assert isinstance(error.value.orig_exc, RepresenterError)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name', ('to_yaml', 'to_nice_yaml'))
+def test_yaml_filter_template_undefined(filter_name):
+    templar = Templar(loader=DataLoader(), variables={})
+    expression = '{{ MYSVC_ENV | %s }}' % filter_name
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleUndefinedVariable) as error:
+        templar.template(expression)
+    assert filter_name in str(error.value)
+    assert 'MYSVC_ENV' in str(error.value)
+    assert isinstance(error.value.orig_exc, UndefinedError)
+    assert templar.template(expression, fail_on_undefined=False) == expression
